every text and number traces to input.note: RU columns, captured rows, proposed keys explicitly identified

text contrast >=4.5:1.note: Exact token ink vs placement surface

edges and icons >=3:1.note: Boundary uses inner edge / outer edge / body contrast; inactive edges exempt per accepted HB-08. Navy primary edge alone against navy is 1:1, inner yellow boundary supplies contrast.

persistent overlap 0px2.note: No persistent HUD; all LOBBY panels are screen layers, excluded by 04 1.6. Not a figure-mask claim for opaque screens.

rows match captured answer.expected: five t0 rows in answer order
rows match captured answer.note: Last two unavailable after list-join-errors, removed next poll

skeleton differs in gray.measured: three text-free placeholders versus five printed rows, missing Join + why text on two rows

layout no clipped or overlapping text.note: Actual Pillow ink bounds, all pairs

fix1 row inset >=8su.note: All row slots and actual text ink; skeleton bars separately. Cursor is not row content; no rows in empty/error.

limitations: Accepted immutable HB-08 screen-panel edge/body boundary is below 3:1 at some native raster samples over the prescribed K1 veil; no skin/token override. Minimum 2.1273:1. Full edge acceptance is not passed.

spacing_changes.recover: L: hidden 40 su slot, right-aligned on error row inside CodeColumn. S: no slot fits, legend only.
